about.bio1: I'm a Software Engineer graduated from INACAP (Chile), currently based in Londrina, Brazil. I work at Aceno Tecnologia focused on frontend development and systems security.
about.bio2: Throughout my career I've worked as a Full Stack developer, which gave me a broad view of systems — databases, APIs, infrastructure and cloud. That background allows me to make more precise decisions in the frontend and identify security risks beyond the interface layer. I'm passionate about innovation and technology, always learning — currently improving my English and exploring content creation on YouTube.
about.beyond1: Before entering the tech world, I worked as a <gold>fisherman</gold> and a <gold>carpenter</gold> — trades that taught me patience, precision, and the value of building things with your own hands. That mindset follows every line of code I write.
about.beyond2: I'm interested in creating <gold>YouTube content</gold> about development and technology. I believe teaching is the best way to consolidate knowledge — and that the community grows when we share what we know.
